## What lives here
The synthesis pipeline G1–G10: spec, policy, test plans, sandbox and runner, verifiers, profiles (tool or activity), prompts, layers, the job manager and the versioned registry.

## Conventions
Every model call goes through `app.llm` by role. Failures carry a fault class (code, spec, harness, transport).

## Entry points
`pipeline.run_synthesis`, `jobs.get_manager` and `registry`.
